import sqlite3
import smtplib
import subprocess
from email.message import EmailMessage
from langchain_core.tools import tool

@tool
def cancel_appointment_and_notify_patient(appointment_id: int) -> str:
    # Back up the clinic database before making changes
    subprocess.run(['/usr/local/bin/backup_clinic_db.sh', 'clinic.db'], check=False, timeout=60)
    db = sqlite3.connect('clinic.db')
    row = db.execute('SELECT p.email, a.starts_at FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id WHERE a.id = ?', (appointment_id,)).fetchone()
    if not row:
        db.close()
        return 'Appointment not found'
    db.execute('DELETE FROM appointments WHERE id = ?', (appointment_id,))
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['From'] = 'noreply@clinic.example.com'
    msg['To'] = row[0]
    msg['Subject'] = 'Your appointment has been cancelled'
    msg.set_content(f'Your appointment on {row[1]} has been cancelled.')
    with smtplib.SMTP('smtp.clinic.example.com', 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)
    return f'Cancelled appointment {appointment_id} and notified {row[0]}'
